title: STIG-hardened ZPA images: password rules and the 2024 password-expiration issue

prose.text: STIG-hardened Private Access images are among the image forms in [[zpa.app-connectors.deployment]]; their password rules and one expiry issue are here.

prose.label: Password rules.
prose.text: {{password-rules}} {{password-rules-scope}} The page's examples for the two repeat limits do not match the limits {{divergence:repeat-examples}}.

prose.label: The 2024 expiry issue.
prose.text: {{expiry-issue}} {{expiry-consequence}} {{identify-and-fix}} Whether Private Cloud Controller and Network Connector images were affected is open {{gap:pcc-nc-affected}}.

checks.do: Whether the image was released on the affected dates and shows ZSIVersion 2024.11 or 2024.12 before its admin password expires.
Whether admin access is already lost, in which case a new App Connector or Private Service Edge must be deployed.
Which repeat limit applies to a rejected password, since the page's examples and limits differ.
Whether a Private Cloud Controller or Network Connector image was affected by the expiry, which no source states.

password-rules.statement: For STIG compliance the page requires passwords to be a minimum of 15 characters, with a minimum change of 8 characters and of 4 character classes (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, special characters are its examples) from the previous password. Its limits are that repeating consecutive characters must not exceed 3 and repeating characters of the same character class must not exceed 4; its table names these settings Maximum Consecutive Repeated Characters (max repeat), Maximum Consecutive Characters of Same Type (max class repeat) and Difference From Previous Password (difok).

quotes: Passwords must be a minimum of 15 characters in length.
A minimum change of 8 characters from the previous password.
A minimum change of 4 character classes (e.g., uppercase, lowercase, numbers, special characters).
The number of repeating consecutive characters must not exceed 3
The number of repeating characters of the same character class must not exceed 4
Maximum Consecutive Repeated Characters (max repeat)
Maximum Consecutive Characters of Same Type (max class repeat)
Difference From Previous Password (difok)

password-rules-scope.statement: The password requirements are relevant for VM platforms (such as VMWare and Nutanix AHV) and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure and GCP) when deploying Private Access components including App Connectors, Private Service Edges, Private Cloud Controllers and Network Connectors.

quotes: These requirements are relevant for VM platforms (such as VMWare and Nutanix AHV) and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, and GCP) when deploying Private Access components, including:
App Connectors
Private Service Edges
Private Cloud Controllers
Network Connectors

expiry-issue.statement: STIG images released on November 24, 2024 (AWS and GCP) and December 12, 2024 (Azure and VMware) automatically expire passwords every 60 days for AWS, GCP and Azure, or 95 days (60 days plus a 35-day grace period) for VMware. STIG images released after these dates are not affected.

quotes: This information applies to Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) images that were released on November 24, 2024, and December 12, 2024. STIG images released after these dates are not affected.
passwords automatically expire every 60 days for Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure, or 95 days (60 days + a 35-day grace period) for VMware.
AWS and GCP: November 24, 2024
Azure and VMware: December 12, 2024

expiry-consequence.statement: If the password expires without being changed or disabled, admin access to an App Connector or Private Service Edge is no longer available, and the only recovery method is to deploy a new App Connector or Private Service Edge.

quotes: If the password expires without being changed or disabled, admin access to an App Connector or Private Service Edge is no longer available. When admin access expires, the only recovery method is to deploy a new App Connector or Private Service Edge.

identify-and-fix.statement: An image is affected if ZSIVersion 2024.11 or 2024.12 appears under Host Platform, or under Private Service Edge Host Platform for a Private Service Edge. The page gives two fixes: disable expiry with sudo chage -M -1 followed by the admin username (its example is admin), or set a password with passwd on a new instance and renew it every 60 days; a second instruction on the page says to renew it every 60 or 95 days.

quotes: Under Host Platform, if you see ZSIVersion: 2024.11 or ZSIVersion: 2024.12, your image is affected by this issue.
Under Private Service Edge Host Platform, if you see ZSIVersion: 2024.11 or ZSIVersion: 2024.12, your image is affected by this issue.
Set a password when creating a new instance using passwd admin (replacing admin with your admin username) and renew it every 60 days.
and renew it every 60 or 95 days.
$ sudo chage -M -1 admin
evidence.after: Disable or set a password for AWS, GCP, and Azure.

repeat-examples.summary: On the STIG password page, the examples given as restricted sit at the stated limit rather than past it, and a further sentence allows the limit's value.

quotes: The number of repeating consecutive characters must not exceed 3 (e.g., aaa is restricted).

positions.says: Repeating consecutive characters must not exceed 3, and aaa (3 repeats) is given as restricted.

quotes: The number of repeating characters of the same character class must not exceed 4 (e.g., abcd is restricted).

positions.says: Repeating characters of the same character class must not exceed 4, and abcd (4 characters of one class) is given as restricted.

quotes: The same character cannot appear more than 3 times consecutively.

positions.says: The same character cannot appear more than 3 times consecutively.

repeat-examples.impact: Whether a password with exactly 3 repeated characters or exactly 4 same-class characters is accepted is not settled by the page.

pcc-nc-affected.title: Whether Private Cloud Controller and Network Connector STIG images were affected by the 2024 expiry
pcc-nc-affected.detail: The password-expiration article names only App Connectors and Private Service Edges. The password requirements article lists Private Cloud Controllers and Network Connectors as components the rules apply to, but no source says whether their STIG images carried the 60 or 95 day expiry.
